title: CBR Warning Signs
description: Describes the warning signs of chemical, biological, and radiological incidents, including chemical agent types and radiation sickness, and how phone alerts, EAS, NOAA Weather Radio, and sirens warn you. Gives the different first steps for each threat, outdoors and indoors.
shortDescription: Spot chemical, biological, and radiological incidents; the first move for each
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
